Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients at high-risk for an acute myocardial infarction, including any 2 of these risk factors: males age > 45; females age >55; family history of premature coronary heart disease (CHD); current cigarette smoker; hypertension; or elevated total cholesterol with low HDL and/or high LDL.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is male >45, has family history of premature CHD (father died at 62), and elevated LDL cholesterol (>190 mg/dL).

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Active angina (chest pain due to coronary heart disease)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of active angina in patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: History of coronary heart disease according to the treating physician
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has a complex cardiac history with multiple myocardial infarctions and coronary artery disease.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Past history of myocardial infarction documented by electrocardiogram or arteriography
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has a documented history of myocardial infarctions requiring emergency stenting and bypass surgery.
Patient has Type 2 diabetes mellitus managed with metformin.
No mention of renal dialysis in patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of recent hospitalization in patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Persons living in a home with previously enrolled patients
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No information about living arrangements or home enrollment status.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients disoriented to person, place, or time at onset of study
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of cognitive disorientation or impairment in patient description.

Recap: Patient meets inclusion criteria for high-risk myocardial infarction (age >45, family history of premature CHD, elevated LDL, history of MI). No exclusion criteria are violated.
